query: INSERT INTO auth_throttle AS t (user_id, kind, failures, window_started_at) VALUES ($1, $2, 1, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, kind) DO UPDATE SET failures = CASE WHEN t.window_started_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => $3) THEN 1 ELSE t.failures + 1 END, window_started_at = CASE WHEN t.window_started_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => $3) THEN now() ELSE t.window_started_at END RETURNING failures
